entries.original_title: Paper page - Reflex: Visually Grounded Reactive Humanoid Control
entries.subtitle: Reflex studies humanoid control that uses vision to react to moving objects, with experiments on catching thrown boxes through whole-body movement.
entries.reject_reason: The tracker hosts a University of Washington paper, but the research is not from a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - SoftwareGym: Scaling Computer-Use Agent Training with Diverse Synthesized Software Environments
entries.subtitle: SoftwareGym proposes an automated pipeline that creates varied, executable GUI software environments to train computer-use agents at scale.
entries.reject_reason: SoftwareGym is research from an untracked university team, merely listed by a tracked model-paper site.

entries.original_title: Paper page - ProgramGym: Scaling Training Environments for Long-Horizon Program Reproduction Agents
entries.subtitle: ProgramGym proposes scalable training environments for agents to reproduce programs over long tasks, including exploring a reference program before implementation.
entries.reject_reason: ProgramGym is not attributed to a tracked entity; using Qwen as an experimental base does not make it Qwen research.

entries.original_title: Paper page - S-Space: Exploring Spatial Workspace in Multimodal Language Models
entries.subtitle: S-Space identifies an internal spatial workspace in multimodal language models, where object representations encode horizontal, vertical, and distance coordinates.
entries.reject_reason: This is a tracker listing for research not attributed to a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Work2Skill: Capturing Human GUI Experience for Reusable Agent Skill Induction
entries.subtitle: Work2Skill captures human GUI demonstrations and separates reusable workflow knowledge from task details to help agents handle unfamiliar software.
entries.reject_reason: Work2Skill is attributed to an untracked team rather than the site listing the paper.

entries.original_title: Paper page - EmbodiedCLBench: Evaluating Continual Learning for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
entries.subtitle: EmbodiedCLBench is a simulation benchmark for testing whether embodied agents can learn basic tasks and combine skills for unseen complex tasks.
entries.reject_reason: The embodied-agent benchmark is attributed to an untracked research team, not the tracker hosting its page.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Here the World in Stereo: Learning Dynamic Spatial Correspondence for Immersive Joint Video-Audio Generation
entries.subtitle: StereoBind links visual source motion to stereo sound generation, aiming to keep perceived sound locations aligned with moving objects.
entries.reject_reason: The stereo audio-video research is not attributed to a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - SepGen: Multi-Stem Audio-Video Separation and Generation in a Single Model
entries.subtitle: SepGen extends an audio-video generator to produce video, mixed audio, and separate waveforms for each sound source in one sampling run.
entries.reject_reason: The SepGen paper appears on a tracker but is not research from a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: togethercomputer/HybridAgent-14B-Agentic
entries.subtitle: Two new Hugging Face uploads add agentic models, each with an MIT license and region us.
entries.reject_reason: The bare Hugging Face uploads do not establish that the Agentic variants are launches of new models rather than derivatives.

entries.original_title: 医師向け検索ツール「Evidence Finder」にSakana Namazuを導入：日本仕様のAIを、医療の現場へ
entries.subtitle: Evidence Finder adopted Sakana Namazu for medical literature search, after its model scored 96.4% on the 120th medical exam, which does not prove clinical usefulness.
entries.reject_reason: Sakana AI describes adoption of its existing Namazu model in another company's medical search tool.

entries.original_title: Shared vs. Dedicated AI Inference: Embed & Rerank
entries.subtitle: For Embed & Rerank, workload size, traffic patterns, latency needs, and costs matter more than request counts when choosing inference.
entries.reject_reason: Cohere offers guidance on sizing existing inference services rather than announcing research or a product update.

entries.original_title: Decider V1.1 27B - API Pricing & Providers
entries.subtitle: Perplexity's Decider V1.1 27B handles up to 128 questions per request and returns probability-based answers for classification, routing, and moderation.
entries.reject_reason: The listing explicitly describes Perplexity Decider V1.1 as a new checkpoint, which the model-release rules exclude.

entries.original_title: Drex v1.5 - API Pricing & Providers
entries.subtitle: Nace.AI's Drex v1.5 is an open-weight decision model with 128K tokens of context, returning scored choices without generated text.
entries.reject_reason: Drex v1.5 is from untracked Nace AI, and a tracker listing does not make Nace AI a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Clef Omni - API Pricing & Providers
entries.subtitle: Cloudflare's Clef Omni accepts text and image input and returns probabilities for typed decisions, supporting classification, routing, scoring, and guardrails.
entries.reject_reason: Clef Omni is a fine-tune from untracked Cloudflare, not a qualifying tracked-entity model launch.

entries.original_title: Step 5 Preview - API Pricing & Benchmarks
entries.subtitle: StepFun's Step 5 Preview targets long agent tasks across large codebases and documents, using tools and multiple refinement steps, with strength in finance.
entries.reject_reason: Step 5 Preview is a model from untracked StepFun, despite appearing on a tracked model-listing site.

entries.original_title: Solar Decide Flash - API Pricing & Providers
entries.subtitle: Upstage's Solar Decide Flash answers typed decision questions in one pass, with a 512K context window and free output tokens.
entries.reject_reason: Solar Decide Flash comes from untracked Upstage rather than a tracked model developer.

entries.original_title: Expanding our enterprise inference capacity with IBM Cloud and NVIDIA
entries.subtitle: Together AI, IBM, and NVIDIA are building a dedicated NVIDIA B300 inference cluster on IBM Cloud for rising enterprise demand.
entries.reject_reason: Together AI announces additional inference capacity through a partnership, not a new product or model.

entries.original_title: Eleven v4 - API Pricing & Benchmarks
entries.subtitle: ElevenLabs' text-to-speech model supports 90+ languages and 10,000-character requests, with a 50% launch offer through October 19, 2026.
entries.reject_reason: Eleven v4 is from untracked ElevenLabs, not a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Cohere and PwC partnership announcement | Cohere
entries.subtitle: Cohere and PwC formed a global alliance, launching first in Canada, to help organizations deploy secure AI across business workflows.
entries.reject_reason: The PwC alliance concerns adoption of Cohere's existing offerings, not a research result or launch.

entries.original_title: Eleven v3 - API Pricing & Benchmarks
entries.subtitle: ElevenLabs' speech model supports 70+ languages and 5,000-character requests, and its launch offer cuts list price by 50% through October 19, 2026.
entries.reject_reason: Eleven v3 is from untracked ElevenLabs, and its tracker page does not establish a tracked-entity launch.

entries.original_title: Sakana AI
entries.subtitle: Sakana AI's free newsletter shares updates on research, products, industrial use, and events about twice a month.
entries.reject_reason: This announces a Sakana AI newsletter rather than a research result, product launch, or model release.
